about_the_game:
Enjoy the first full area of the game: The Beach of Idle Haste.

Learn the ropes, equip yourself with a pool of around 50 mementos available in this demo and defeat the first boss in this small taste of the full game!

One day, Julio wakes up in the Labyrinth Beyond Time and Space having forgotten his past.

With the help of his boyfriend, Amador, he must remember how he ended up in this place and how to get out.

Aim your way to victory, use the power of the elements to your advantage and discover the meaning of love, oranges and what tomorrow holds in this demo!

  • Enjoy the first area fully: A beach where time is accelerated! That's around 2 hours of beach!

  • A unique take on progression, where you must figure out a strategy from random equipment you scavenge. It's like a combo between a rogue-like and a randomizer.

  • Transfer your progress to the full game once it's out!

  • An optional (and exclusive) challenge if you get to the end of the demo!

  • If you're reading this far in, I'm sure you'll find much more to enjoy!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux version 2016+
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300 or Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux version 2020+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
